\section*{Not covered by the patch: reproductions}
\subsection*{p.~289}A second above mark on a precomposed letter that already has one. Italic ö and ä have no above anchor in either font (stage 9 inherits an above anchor only for letters without an above mark), so the grave is not anchored and lands on the diaeresis; regular ä has a stacking anchor, and so does italic ā (ā́ in volume 614 is anchored). Not covered by the patch.\par\smallskip

\subsection*{Checked in context: not font problems}Encoding typos, not font problems. p.~85, (b), a starred example: \emph{ŋwàʼnyə̀ ̀ piŋ} has a second grave after a space, which prints as a loose grave after ə̀. p.~87, \emph{pe ́ exclude such DPs}: a space between e and U+0301, which prints as a loose acute; \emph{pé} is meant (as on the next line). The PDF also sets some IPA in the TIPA fonts (tipa8--10), which this scan does not see.\par\medskip
